recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: karl the fog settling over san francisco rooftops
autumn equinox light thinning through the bay
ai agents stitching product films frame by frame
agent config files waking only when someone is watching
shipping deadlines measured in sunrise countdowns
parallel model brains planning side by side in one chat

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Vacuum drifting fog wisps before sunrise burns them away — hold to pull pockets of mist toward you while golden light creeps from the horizon.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: hold to magnetize nearby fog wisps toward your thumb
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each round ends at sunrise with a wisp tally and the skyline briefly clearing
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: sun angle rises, wisps evaporate faster, wind scatters remaining pockets sideways
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: muted watercolor fog over a silhouette golden gate skyline

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Lane-switch between parallel agent threads — swipe to route each prompt to the right model before the wrong brain answers and derails the build.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: swipe left or right to commit context to an agent lane
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: ship-by-sunrise countdown — three clean handoffs before dawn breaks the streak
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: extra agent lanes open, prompts grow longer, merge-conflict obstacles block lanes
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon terminal wireframe on deep black with pulsing cursor blinks

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flick agent orbs from your phone along curved deployment paths — they must bounce through GitHub Action nodes before the pipeline times out.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to aim a curved arc, release to launch the agent orb
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: chain three successful deploys before the phone screen dims to sleep
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: failed-build boulders and flaky-test magnets appear mid-arc, shrinking the safe corridor
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout icons pinned to a cork board with hand-drawn trajectory ghosts

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: An AI scrambles your product demo frames — drag each clip into timeline slots before the preview auto-plays and exposes the wrong story.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: drag frames into ordered slots on a horizontal film strip
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: nail the sequence and watch a perfect five-second reel play back instantly
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: more nearly-identical frames, subtle motion-blur differences, shrinking edit window
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: lo-fi video editor UI with VHS grain and scrub-bar glow
